templates.label: Product page template
templates.help: Which layout a product page uses. T1 Classic: photos with thumbnails beside the buy column. T2 Editorial: on a phone the photos peek one into the next with no arrows; on a computer every photo is stacked two across beside a narrower buy column, on a plain white page with a larger title. A product's own template (chosen when it is uploaded) wins, then its category's (the nearest one up the tree), then the shop's default. With the preview on, an address ending in ?template=T2 shows that template, for checking before you switch; search engines are sent to the plain address.
